ideas.idea: Product JSON-LD is fragile: lists several products but declares one generic Bilge pump; use ItemList/per-product data, and build with JSON.stringify and escape <
ideas.why: The shop page lists bilge pumps, cleats and rope but the hand-written {@html} JSON-LD names only one product.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite JSON-LD to the homepage with name, url, logo, sameAs
ideas.why: The homepage has no structured data, and brand entity markup helps machines identify the site.

ideas.idea: Add viewport meta tag to src/app.html
ideas.why: app.html has no viewport meta, so mobile rendering and mobile-first indexing suffer.
The page is noindex, so improving its title has almost no effect.

ideas.idea: Don't add a Disallow for /search in robots.txt so crawlers can see the noindex
ideas.why: This is correct for the repo: robots.txt allows /search, so the noindex stays visible to crawlers.

ideas.idea: Improve titles/descriptions: add brand and keyword to the home title, add a brand to the shop title, expand the home description
ideas.why: These are the actual titles and descriptions in the files, and the shop title has no brand.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the delivery notice and move the text into page content
ideas.why: This reverses the deliberate, scoped data-nosnippet choice.

ideas.idea: Move the delivery notice out of its odd placement after children / into a footer
ideas.why: This is a minor structural tidy-up with little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card tags via a shared component
ideas.why: No page has OG or Twitter tags, so shared links lack titles and images.

ideas.idea: Thin content: add product pages with unique copy, specs, FAQs and delivery/returns info
ideas.why: Pushing FAQs and content volume is folklore, though real product pages would help; the FAQ framing is mandatory-FAQ advice.

ideas.idea: Use <main> and <footer> landmarks and an aria-label on nav
ideas.why: The layout has no <main> or <footer>, so landmarks help parsers find the main content.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap dynamically via +server.ts and add lastmod
ideas.why: The sitemap has only 2 URLs, so the benefit is small and the advice is common to any site.
llms.txt as a way to be found is folklore, and the report's own caveat doesn't change that.

ideas.idea: Add explicit AI-crawler groups to robots.txt
ideas.why: The * group already allows them, so this only states a policy and applies to any site.

ideas.idea: Add a favicon, link rel=alternate and hreflang en-GB
ideas.why: This is boilerplate for any site, and hreflang is only needed if multiple regions are served.
